title: 第21章 血肉造物第22章 激战
content_zh:
冰裂谷深处，寒意似乎被某种更沉重的东西取代，空气里的硫磺味淡了，取而代之的是一种腐烂内脏的腥臭。
脚下的冰面也不再是光滑如镜，覆盖着一层薄薄的、暗红色的粘稠物质，踩上去发出令人牙酸的“噗叽”
声。
小咔在前方带路，它似乎对这股恶臭毫无反应，只是偶尔会停下来，侧着它那双蓝白色的冰眸望向通道更深处。
眼眸中不再是纯粹的好奇，而是掺杂了一丝警惕，它用手势示意凯撒跟上，动作比之前急促了一些。
凯撒的心悬着，铁矛攥得死紧，越往里走那股无形的压力越大，压得他胸口发闷。
凯撒忍不住低声道：“小咔，这地方到底通向哪儿？
小咔回头看了他一眼，冰眸眨了眨，只是又用力朝前面指了指。
通道陡然开阔，一个巨大的冰窟出现在眼前，冰窟中央的景象，让凯撒胃里一阵翻江倒海。
那是一个巨大的天然冰穴，冰穴中央，一个“东西”
被囚禁在那里。
那是一个……一个勉强还能看出人形的巨大肉堆！
它瘫坐在冰窟中央，像一座由猩红血肉胡乱堆砌成的肉山。
体型是正常人的三四倍，肌肉虬结膨胀到了畸形的程度，皮肤被撑得近乎透明，露出底下粗大的暗红色血管。
那些肌肉块像是活物般微微蠕动着，不断有粘稠的血液从皮肤破裂的缝隙里渗出，滴落在身下的冰面上。
它的头颅深陷在过度发达的肌肉里，几乎看不见脖子，只能看到一个模糊的面部轮廓，两只眼睛的位置是毫无生气的暗红色光点。
这肌肉怪人似乎察觉到了有人过来，庞大的身体如肉山般冲了过来。
“我……”
凯撒倒抽一口凉气，感觉后颈的汗毛全都竖了起来。
这东西光是看着，就让人生理不适到了极点，它散发出的压迫感，比之前遇到的任何怪物都要暴戾。

“轰——！
！”
一声沉闷的巨响在冰穴中炸开，那根坚硬无比的冰柱表面，瞬间布满了蛛网般的恐怖裂痕！
就在凯撒以为冰柱要彻底崩碎的瞬间，站在他身旁的小咔动了，它那双蓝白色的眼眸亮起微光，手臂朝着那根濒临破碎的冰柱遥遥一指。
“咻——”
一道带着冰蓝色光点的寒气激射而出，精准地缠绕上那根布满裂痕的冰柱。
那些巨大的裂缝，以肉眼可见的速度被冰蓝色的寒光重新凝结，血肉怪物似乎对冰柱的复原毫无反应。
content_en:
Deep in the ice-cracked valley, the chill seemed to be replaced by something heavier. The smell of sulfur in the air faded, replaced by a fishy stench of rotting internal organs.
The ice surface under your feet is no longer as smooth as a mirror. It is covered with a thin layer of dark red sticky substance, which makes a tooth-staining "Puff" sound when you step on it.
sound.
Xiao Ka led the way. It seemed to have no reaction to the stench. It only occasionally stopped and looked deeper into the passage with its blue-white ice eyes.
The eyes were no longer pure curiosity, but mixed with a hint of vigilance. It gestured for Caesar to follow, and its movements were a little more hurried than before.
Caesar's heart was hanging, and he clenched the iron spear tightly. The further he went in, the greater the invisible pressure became, making his chest feel tight.
Caesar couldn't help but whispered: "Xiao Ka, where does this place lead to?
Xiaoka looked back at him, blinked his ice eyes, and pointed forward vigorously.
The passage suddenly opened up, and a huge ice cave appeared in front of him. The scene in the center of the ice cave made Caesar's stomach churn.
It was a huge natural ice cave. In the center of the ice cave, there was a "thing"
Imprisoned there.
It was...a huge pile of flesh that could barely be seen as human-shaped!
It sat paralyzed in the center of the ice cave, like a mountain of scarlet flesh piled haphazardly.
The body size is three to four times that of a normal person, the muscle knots have swelled to the point of deformity, and the skin is stretched almost transparent, revealing the thick dark red blood vessels underneath.
Those muscles were squirming slightly like living creatures, and thick blood was constantly leaking from the cracks in the skin and dripping on the ice beneath him.
Its head was sunk deeply into overdeveloped muscles, and its neck was almost invisible. Only a vague facial outline could be seen, and the positions of its two eyes were lifeless dark red light spots.
This muscular weirdo seemed to sense that someone was coming, and his huge body rushed over like a mountain of flesh.
"I..."
Caesar gasped and felt the hairs on the back of his neck stand up.
Just looking at this thing makes people feel physically uncomfortable to the extreme. The oppressive feeling it exudes is more violent than any monster encountered before.
“Boom——!
! "
A dull loud noise exploded in the ice cave, and the surface of the extremely hard icicle was instantly covered with spiderweb-like terrifying cracks!
Just when Caesar thought the icicle was about to completely collapse, the little Kaker standing next to him moved, its blue-white eyes shimmered, and its arm pointed far away at the icicle that was on the verge of breaking.
"Whoops——"
A stream of cold air with icy blue light spots shot out and accurately wrapped around the cracked icicle.
Those huge cracks were re-condensed by the ice-blue cold light at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the flesh-and-blood monster seemed to have no reaction to the restoration of the icicles.
